packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/__in.name: Gateway package
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/__in.description: Marks the worker's gateway code as one package; holds no logic of its own.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/atte.name: Attention projection
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/atte.description: Turns meaningful runtime changes into one audited item for the owner's attention, retrying safely and setting aside anything that keeps failing.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/brok.name: Broker relay (worker side)
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/brok.description: The always-on worker's side of answering the main server's broker reads.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/conn.name: Live connection upkeep
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/conn.description: Keeps voice and other live connections healthy and closes them cleanly.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/even.name: Event dispatch
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/even.description: Sends each runtime event to the right place: channels, integrations and notifications.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/heal.name: Worker health
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/heal.description: Reports the worker is healthy only while its heartbeat is fresh and no critical step has stalled.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/hist.name: History upkeep
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/hist.description: Runs the optional conversation summaries in the background.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/live.name: Step supervision
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/live.description: Runs each background step on its own and keeps track of whether it is alive.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/owne.name: Owner cards from events
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/owne.description: Raises and settles owner action cards straight from runtime events, with no model involved.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/proc.name: Process id
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/proc.description: Gives the worker process a unique id.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/push.name: Phone push delivery
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/push.description: Sends due notifications to the owner's phones through Expo and reads back the delivery receipts, dropping a phone reported gone.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/reco.name: Expired-run recovery
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/reco.description: Finds runs whose lease has expired so they can be recovered.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/run_.name: Run dispatch
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/run_.description: Starts each queued agent run on the right model.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/runt.name: Owner services
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/runt.description: Builds the set of services the worker uses for one owner.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/sche.name: Scheduler tick
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/sche.description: Runs one pass of each scheduled step.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/serv.name: The worker
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/serv.description: The always-on worker itself: it runs all the background steps that keep agents, trading and notifications going.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/shut.name: Graceful shutdown
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/shut.description: Drains work and returns the worker's leases when it stops.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/thre.name: Archive handling
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/thre.description: When the owner has turned off keeping conversations archived, brings an archived conversation back to the list on a new message.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/wake.name: Market wake dispatch
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/wake.description: Checks the market watches and wakes agents when one fires.

packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/watc.name: Watchdog
packages/gateway/src/lonora_gateway/watc.description: A model-free check that keeps the worker honest, catching operations and runs that went wrong.
